summary: Kerb where cars park, backing onto a shop car park; no homes close.
reasons: Apartments 25 m or more from first 15 m

drivers.seclusion: North side is a retail building and its car park; nearest apartments are about 25-38 m away at 0-15 m, 12 m only at the 35 m end.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide street with a parking lane; several cars parked along both sides in Esri and QLD.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street off a busy 50 km/h road; the van would be among parked cars.
drivers.convention: Cars park along this kerb, so a van will not stand out.

flags: Low-lying: about 5.8 m elevation, Toowong Creek 46 m away
Apartments (Campbellbrook) 12 m from the 35 m end
Noise from the nearby main road
sun_shade: Open in the morning; a tree shades the west end in the afternoon.
cannot_judge: Whether the shops operate at night

best_section.where: Campbell Street north kerb, beside the shop car park, west end of the stretch
